The film was directed by Len Wiseman and stars Bruce Willis as John McClane.  The film's name was adapted from New Hampshire's state motto, "Live Free or Die".
Renny Harlin | Renny Harlin (born Lauri Mauritz Harjola; 15 March 1959) is a Finnish film director, producer and screenwriter.  His films include "", "Die Hard 2", "Cliffhanger", "The Long Kiss Goodnight," "Deep Blue Sea and Driven."

Underworld: Evolution | Underworld: Evolution is a 2006 American action horror film directed by Len Wiseman.  The film is a sequel to the 2003 film, "Underworld" and the second installment in the "Underworld" franchise.  In the film, Selene and Michael fight to protect the future of the Corvinus bloodline from its hidden past.
